annotations.description: Flickering the opponent's Chains of Custody returns Sigiled Starfish, but when Chains re-enters attached to Angelic Cub, the opponent gets to exile another nonland permanent. This spends a card (Flicker of Fate) for essentially no net gain since the opponent just re-exiles something. Meanwhile, Aegis Turtle is a solid 0/5 blocker for just U that could help stabilize the board.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Flicker of Fate targeting opponent's Chains of Custody
annotations.betterLine: Cast Aegis Turtle for U as a defensive body, saving Flicker of Fate for later when it can generate real value (e.g., flickering own ETB creatures like Wispweaver Angel or resetting a Faith's Fetters target).

annotations.description: Faith's Fetters was targeted at Llama4 Valley's own Aegis Turtle (0/5 defender) instead of the opponent's Angelic Cub (5/5 flyer). This wastes the removal spell, disables their own blocker, and leaves the opponent's lethal flying threat untouched. At 8 life facing a 5/5 flyer and a 2/2 flyer, this is almost certainly game-losing.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted own Aegis Turtle with Faith's Fetters
annotations.betterLine: Target the opponent's Angelic Cub (5/5 flyer) with Faith's Fetters to neutralize the biggest threat and gain 4 life, buying significant time.

annotations.description: Not blocking with Aegis Turtle against the 6/6 Angelic Cub means taking 8 damage (6+2) instead of just 2, dropping from 12 to 4 life instead of 10. At 4 life, the opponent can kill next turn with Angelic Cub + Debaser or Perilous Myr death trigger. Both lines lead to the Turtle dying eventually, but going to 4 life is far more precarious than 10 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block, taking 8 damage and falling to 4 life
annotations.betterLine: Block Angelic Cub with Aegis Turtle (blockers: 'p37:attacker_id'). The Turtle dies to the 6/6 but absorbs 6 damage, leaving Llama4 at 10 life with much more room to stabilize with Wispweaver Angel or Pursued Whale.

annotations.description: At 4 life facing a 5/5 flying Angelic Cub that attacks next turn, Llama4 Valley cast Unstable Obelisk (a mana rock) instead of Rousing Read on Aegis Turtle, which would have created a 1/6 flyer capable of blocking the Cub. Without a flying blocker, the opponent attacks for lethal next turn. Rousing Read also draws 2 cards to find more answers.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Unstable Obelisk, a mana rock with no immediate defensive impact
annotations.betterLine: Cast Rousing Read on Aegis Turtle to create a 1/6 flying blocker that survives combat with the 5/5 Angelic Cub (taking 5 damage with 6 toughness). This forces the opponent to sacrifice Phyrexian Debaser to push through lethal, and the card draw might find additional answers.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 4 life with only Aegis Turtle (1/6 flying via Rousing Read) as a blocker. Attacking with all three creatures (Angelic Cub 5/5 flying, Phyrexian Debaser 3/3 flying, Perilous Myr 1/1) guarantees lethal since the turtle can only block one attacker. If turtle blocks Angelic Cub, Debaser (3) + Perilous Myr (1) = 4 = exactly lethal. By leaving Perilous Myr back, the opponent can block Angelic Cub and survive at 1 life (taking only 3 from Debaser).
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only Angelic Cub and Phyrexian Debaser, leaving Perilous Myr back.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with all three creatures (Angelic Cub, Phyrexian Debaser, and Perilous Myr) to guarantee lethal damage regardless of how the opponent blocks.

annotations.description: At 4 life facing 8 damage from Angelic Cub (5) and Phyrexian Debaser (3), the player declined to block, taking lethal damage. Blocking the Angelic Cub with Aegis Turtle (1/6 with flying from Rousing Read) would have prevented 5 damage, leaving them alive at 1 life with the Turtle surviving.
annotations.actionTaken: Did not block, taking 8 damage at 4 life (lethal).
annotations.betterLine: Block Angelic Cub with Aegis Turtle to survive at 1 life. The Turtle (1/6) survives combat against the 5/5 Cub, and only the Debaser's 3 damage gets through.
